  • October 23, 2026At home

    Let the house decide what's for dinner

    By the end of a workday we have nothing left for the question "what do you want to eat?" So now one button picks a meal from a hundred, recipe included.

  • October 10, 2026At home

    River's astrophysics phase is accelerating

    River keeps asking about space and aliens. Well, space and alien games. So he got ten worlds, 30 stars and a grumpy robot king to tickle. It's a start.

  • October 7, 2026At home

    River's Halloween Craft Adventure

    River's homework asked what his teachers should be for Halloween. We dressed them up in felt and pom-poms, then turned the finished page into two little animated films, one in English and one in French.

  • October 5, 2026At home

    River's French homework: a fire escape plan

    River's French class sent home a fire safety project for the weekend. We made our family escape plan in French, and then I had it animated with River in it.
